title: The Low Gate That Stuck Half Open
youtube_title: The Low Gate That Stuck Half Open | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a low gate stuck half open on a pebble is awkward for one person. Bibi notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
